problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:
* Package 1: weight 41kg, revenue 35 credits
* Package 2: weight 50kg, revenue 221 credits
* Package 3: weight 39kg, revenue 247 credits
* Package 4: weight 3kg, revenue 286 credits
* Package 5: weight 21kg, revenue 113 credits
* Package 6: weight 21kg, revenue 93 credits
* Package 7: weight 2kg, revenue 176 credits
* Package 8: weight 32kg, revenue 47 credits
* Package 9: weight 36kg, revenue 216 credits
* Package 10: weight 20kg, revenue 285 credits
* Package 11: weight 12kg, revenue 125 credits
* Package 12: weight 43kg, revenue 18 credits
* Package 13: weight 31kg, revenue 69 credits
* Package 14: weight 45kg, revenue 115 credits
* Package 15: weight 29kg, revenue 158 credits
* Package 16: weight 38kg, revenue 165 credits
* Package 17: weight 19kg, revenue 13 credits
* Package 18: weight 46kg, revenue 189 credits
* Package 19: weight 18kg, revenue 56 credits
* Package 20: weight 1kg, revenue 22 credits
* Package 21: weight 30kg, revenue 34 credits
* Package 22: weight 10kg, revenue 53 credits
* Package 23: weight 4kg, revenue 141 credits
* Package 24: weight 20kg, revenue 47 credits
* Package 25: weight 5kg, revenue 51 credits
* Package 26: weight 15kg, revenue 27 credits
* Package 27: weight 41kg, revenue 170 credits

The drone has a maximum payload capacity of 470 kg. Determine which packages to load to maximize total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
